body.p: In a "Notice to File Corrected Application Papers" dated June 23, 2022, the application

was described as containing "text that is unreadable or of insufficient clarity." Notice to File Corrected Application Papers, Page 1. Applicant has amended the specification to remove unreadable text. Applicant respectfully submits that no new matter has been added
Additionally, in "Notice to File Corrected Application Papers" dated June 23, 2022, the application was described as containing "one or more figures that appear to be unnumbered or

misnumbered in comparison to the brief description of the figures." Notice to File Corrected Application Papers, Page 1. Applicant has amended the specification to add a brief description of figures 8A and 8B. Applicant respectfully submits that no new matter has been added.
